findings.title: Fallback locale preloading only happens on web requests, not in jobs/mailers/console
findings.body: The new `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` call is only wired into `ApplicationController#set_locale`, which runs as a before_filter on controller actions. Background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, and console sessions that switch `I18n.locale` and translate text never trigger this preload step. Since `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb#translate` only lazily loads the *current* locale (not the fallback chain), and `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate` performs lookups against whatever translations happen to already be loaded in memory, any fallback locale (site default locale or `:en`) that hasn't been separately loaded in that process context will simply be treated as having no translations, silently defeating the fallback feature outside of the request/response cycle. This makes the fallback feature incomplete for a large class of use cases (e.g. localized emails, job notifications).

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash but ignores all Hash mutation semantics
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList` extends `Hash` yet overrides only `[]` to always recompute `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]` on every call, ignoring any entries actually stored in the hash. Any code (current or future, including third-party plugins or admin tooling) that relies on the standard I18n fallback API to customize mappings (e.g. `I18n.fallbacks[:xx] = [:yy]`, `I18n.fallbacks.map(...)`) will silently have no effect, since `[]=`/`store`/`merge!` write into the underlying Hash storage that `[]` never reads from. This is a misleading API surface that can mask configuration bugs.

findings.title: Custom fallback chain drops locale-tag hierarchy fallback (regional variants)
findings.body: The previous Rails-provided `I18n::Locale::Fallbacks` (enabled via `config.i18n.fallbacks = true`) resolves fallback chains based on locale tag structure (e.g. `zh-TW` -> `zh` -> default -> `en`). The replacement `FallbackLocaleList#[]` only returns `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`, with no intermediate base-language fallback. The TODO comment in the same file acknowledges this limitation but it represents an actual regression in translation coverage for locale variants that previously could fall back to their base language before hitting the site default or English.

findings.title: No automated tests for the new fallback mechanism
findings.body: This PR introduces a custom `FallbackLocaleList`, a new `I18n.ensure_loaded!`/`ensure_loaded!` preloading path, and changes to `set_locale`, but no specs verify that: (1) translations fall back correctly from user locale to site default locale to English, (2) `ensure_loaded!` actually loads the expected locale files, or (3) removing the environment-specific `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` settings and enabling fallbacks globally (now including development/test environments, where it previously was not enabled) doesn't change existing test expectations around missing/fallback translations. Given this is a behavior change that spans multiple environments and files, the lack of coverage is a notable gap.
